scope: All40 original LIBERO source goals, official frozen OpenPI40 pi0.5 only. Assessment trajectories are source-assessment-only and are not admitted to pretraining. No target90/Plus/Pro/task44/task57/screen data.
case_interpretation: Two fixed source-familiar physical states per goal, new assessment episodes. Disclose historical exposure/reuse; no unseen-case or population-perfect claim. No post-outcome case substitution.
role_binding: Final is the current pre-existing canonical terminal TRAIN leaf per goal as of adoption, frozen in one SHA-bound inventory before new outcomes. No per-goal checkpoint selection from scores. If competing canonical leaves are unresolved, resolve provenance before dispatch. No new training to manufacture missing actors.
initial_binding: Only actual retained pre-first-SGD initial checkpoint/state with original identity/config. Missing initial is explicit NOT_AVAILABLE for both initialized roles; never reconstruct by guessed seed or call final/native a measured learning curve. Freeze availability before outcome collection.
paired_controls: Same actual post-settle simulator/public observations, instructions and case-reset fork per goal/state. Policy sampling keys are fixed prospectively; initialized/final sampled actors use the same key schedule. Full-H native and tiled32D controls have different noise parameterizations, recorded honestly; no same-shape noise claim between them. Restore declared assessment RNG forks rather than contaminating source training RNG.
query_seed_rule: 20261101 + 1000*canonical_source_goal_ordinal + physical_initial_state_id; exact task ordinal/mapping frozen in inventory
cost_policy: Every actual settling/primitive action and unresolved physical intent counts. Qualification is embedded in the first planned native episode; no extra episode/settling/search/retry bought with early success. A failed episode retains its full natural horizon; no action truncation to complete the schedule. If ceilings intervene, preserve exact partial results and recovery.
motor_contract: Qualified OpenPI215 Python3.11 / DSRL7f489 / LIBERO87edbd1; H10/execute10. Preserve each archived TRAIN actor exact input/noise/postprocessing contract; no Motus/RLinf130 paths.
assessment: Report per-goal/role paired success, duration and all-in actions; final mean versus initial mean only where genuinely available, and stochastic versus stochastic separately. Final mean is the DPT-label-mode competence question. Native-to-tied or tied-to-bounded-SAC change is not learning. Two physical cases per goal are a small descriptive panel, not a blanket competence certificate.
eligibility: No per-task positive binary-success gain requirement, goal filtering, teacher/source/student automatic admission or old-history upgrade. A competent ceiling teacher can be useful for DPT. All failures/regressions/missing comparisons remain in the report.
preservation: Existing actors/full recoveries/original data and all sealed ledgers stay immutable. Read-only model assessment creates a fresh phase/header/clock and full evaluation cursor/global-private-motor RNG recovery. Prior teacher learning costs are linked/report-once provenance, not charged a second time as new interactions. No legacy/V2 retrofit or cold source restart.
